note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Times are fictional labels. "Reciprocal" and "unilateral" are supplied configurations only — who holds which commitment; neither scene is shown as lacking anything, and nothing states whether a commitment binds, is enforceable or valid, or whether a contract is formed.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, labels, captions, references and time labels, three terms, two shared facts and a neutral note. Standing coordinator rule item 20 (caps with the true reason). The pre-cap values are kept in LAW-0459.presets.precap.json. Each capped field was restored alone to its pre-cap value on top of the shipped preset and rendered: the guide 49 -> 67 and the neutral note 38 -> 67 each make 1:1 keep its text only by fading both stages out at the hold (0 of 4 people visible at the hold; the standing rule keeps the people at the hold). With both restored: the same. The capped guide stays longer than its baseline (49 against 47); the baseline neutral note is empty; every count is kept. Shipped: 16:9 17 px, heads 67.0 px; 9:16 22 px, 60.5 px; 1:1 16.1 px, 50.8 px, 4 people at the hold (rendered).
